evals.prompt: Create a friendly folded-paper bird on a miniature Blender set, with tabs and no animation.
assertions: Avoids clay fingerprints and unnecessary rigging.

evals.prompt: The clay animation uses random object jitter and glossy repeating fingerprints. Repair its stop-motion feel.
evals.expected_output: Restore material scale and intentional performance.

evals.prompt: Build a folded-card bird with a visible net/assembly explanation, front/back stock and tabs. Show the reverse side and miniature final view; do not turn it into a clay sculpt.
evals.expected_output: Editable panel/fold/tab construction and assembly/material diagnostics.
assertions: Paper panels, cut edges and tabs explain volume.
The reverse is inspected for interpenetration.
Grain is subordinate to folds and not concrete-like.

evals.prompt: A felt puppet has gravel-sized bump and long fur hiding every seam; its stepped walk slips on held contact frames. Diagnose and repair without introducing a wooden mechanism or random jitter.
evals.expected_output: Felt-scale material and stuffing/seam repairs plus contact-aware stepped timing checks.
assertions: Fiber scale and seams are examined at final size.
Held contact frames are corrected in poses, not hidden with blur.
Actual playback is required for motion acceptance and otherwise remains unverified.
